video.source: client-supplied (repo uploads) — four clips concatenated into ONE continuous scrub timeline, never split across sections: the original hero clip, then "scroll scrubbed 2.mp4" (zoom out to a front-on brain close-up), then the whole of "scroll scrubbed merge.mp4" appended unbroken (the brain wires up and the Dubai skyline resolves inside it, then the brain disperses into a growth-chart of towers). "scroll scrubbed merge.mp4" superseded the old "scroll scrubbed 3.mp4" / "scroll scrubbed 4.mp4" pair, re-rendering their seam as one continuous sequence; the two old files were deleted.
video.optimization: re-encoded H.264 ALL-INTRA (-g 1: every frame a keyframe), crf24, faststart, audio removed. The two clips were re-encoded to identical codec parameters and joined with an ffmpeg concat filter before this final all-intra pass, so every frame across the full merged timeline — not just each original clip — is independently seekable. All-intra makes an arbitrary seek a single-frame decode instead of decoding forward from the previous keyframe, which is what makes scroll-scrubbing feel smooth.
